ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The diagram shows the life cycle of a flea. What letter represents the eggs?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a schematic diagram of the flea life cycle, with several stages connected by arrows. In the box labeled B above is an adult flea; in the box labeled A below is a slender larva; in the box labeled C on the left it looks like a cocoon or pupa; in the box labeled E on the right is a group of small white oval-shaped objects. Reasoning: In a life cycle diagram, eggs are usually drawn as a group of small oval-shaped objects. The box where this group of small white oval objects is located in the diagram is labeled E, so the letter representing eggs is E.
